snippet.title: Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor | Nintendo Switch | Official Trailer | Out Now!
snippet.description:
Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor is out now on Nintendo Switch! 
 
Master the Shunting challenge; explore with Timetable mode or collect the hidden items across Sodor. 

https://bit.ly/Wondors-Of-Sodor-on-Switch-4 

Also available now on Steam, Epic Games, Xbox and PlayStation!
